bio: Located in the historic heart of The Caledonian Edinburgh, The Lounge is the perfect setting for an unforgettable Afternoon Tea, light lunch or elegant evening cocktails in Edinburgh’s city centre.  Their gifted pastry chefs create a seasonal Afternoon Tea menu that can only be matched by the finest teas this world has to offer, while our experienced team of bartenders craft a selection of true classics and signature Caledonian cocktails, using only the finest spirits and freshest ingredients. Unwind in the historic surrounds of The Lounge, reminiscing over the heritage and charm of Scotland’s capital city.  Hailing from the tennis court to the rugby pitch, discover your ‘perfect match’ this summer in The Lounge, embracing a season of British Sports. Taste your way through an abundance of fresh summer berries, sweet and savoury treats and delectable creations, one bite at a time, in the heart of The Caley.
